    Deep rays and annihilation by the radical #

    In the BGRS ray category of a preadditive category C whose endomorphism rings have nilpotent Jacobson radicals, a ray is right-deep exactly when its representatives are killed by every morphism after them whose ray is not invertible (rightDeep_kill, rightDeep_of_kill), and dually for left-deep rays. The point is that a zero ray product may hide a nonzero composite (a "special zero" μ ≫ ν = (μ ≫ ρ) ≫ ν with ρ radical); iterating this with the nilpotency of the radical gives a genuine zero.
